assumptions.bus_equivalents: 100 distance-equivalent normalizing units, not an observed fleet/one-for-one replacement count
assumptions.annual_distance_source: TransLink 2020 fleet plan, Appendix D: 68000 km per 40-ft vehicle per year
assumptions.intensity_source: Historical 40-ft 1.37--2.0 kWh/km range; 1.6 is in-route BEB reference, transferred to a hypothetical charging-window relaxation
assumptions.consumption_boundary: Battery-delivered energy is assumed here; dividing by charging efficiency is explicit and must be removed if a measured meter-energy intensity is used

diesel_budget_price.status: 2023 budget assumption, not actual delivered price

central_comparison.warning: Energy bills only. Not a complete project economic score, grant score, cost forecast or certified procurement alternative.

computation.checks: Every feasible optimum matches independent closed-form cumulative-energy bound and has no power/window/energy residual violation
